name: 工单分析域基线（建模·评测夹具）

cases.question: 工单总数是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 按状态统计工单数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY status
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 4 行。

cases.question: 按优先级统计工单数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT priority, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY priority
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。

cases.question: 按来源统计工单数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY source
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 4 行。

cases.question: 状态为已关闭的工单有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'CLOSED'
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 评论里内部备注有多少条？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket_comment WHERE deleted = 0 AND is_internal = 1
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 按工单分类统计工单数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket t JOIN ticket_category c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.name
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。

cases.question: 处理团队 3 的工单有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND team_id = 3
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 按流转后的状态统计流转次数
cases.goldSql: SELECT to_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket_flow WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY to_status
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 4 行。

cases.question: 优先级为 1 的工单有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND priority = 1
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 按分类名称统计已关闭工单的数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket t JOIN ticket_category c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 'CLOSED' GROUP BY c.name
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。

cases.question: 来自 WEB 渠道的工单有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND source = 'WEB'
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 2025 年 3 月创建的工单有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= '2025-03-01' AND created_at < '2025-04-01'
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 每个分类下的工单平均评论数是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(cm.id) AS cnt FROM ticket t JOIN ticket_category c ON t.category_id = c.id JOIN ticket_comment cm ON cm.ticket_id = t.id AND cm.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.name
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。

cases.question: 按创建月份统计 2025 年的工单数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS ym, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND created_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ym
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 12 行。

cases.question: 每个优先级里状态为已关闭的工单有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT priority, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'CLOSED' GROUP BY priority
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。

cases.question: 按来源和状态统计工单数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT source, status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY source, status
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 16 行。

cases.question: 2025 年下半年（7 到 12 月）创建的工单有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= '2025-07-01' AND created_at < '2026-01-01'
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 评论条数最多的前 5 张工单，各自有多少条评论？
cases.goldSql: SELECT ticket_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket_comment WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY ticket_id ORDER BY cnt DESC, ticket_id LIMIT 5
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。

cases.question: AI 推荐分类与实际分类不一致的工单有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND ai_category_id <> category_id
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 平均每张工单有多少次状态流转？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0) AS avg_flow FROM ticket_flow WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 每个处理团队的平均 AI 置信度是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT team_id, AVG(ai_confidence) AS avg_conf FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY team_id
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 6 行。

cases.question: 2025 年第一季度创建的工单按来源统计数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-04-01' GROUP BY source
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 4 行。

cases.question: 2025 年创建的工单里，已解决的工单占比是多少？用 0 到 1 之间的小数表示
cases.goldSql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('RESOLVED','CLOSED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS ratio FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND created_at < '2026-01-01'
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 已关闭的工单从创建到关闭平均用了多少小时？
cases.goldSql: SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, created_at, closed_at)) AS avg_hours FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'CLOSED' AND closed_at IS NOT NULL
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 已解决的工单从创建到解决平均用了多少分钟？
cases.goldSql: SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, created_at, resolved_at)) AS avg_minutes FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('RESOLVED','CLOSED') AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 按分类统计工单中内部备注占全部评论的比例
cases.goldSql: SELECT c.name, SUM(CASE WHEN cm.is_internal = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS ratio FROM ticket t JOIN ticket_category c ON t.category_id = c.id JOIN ticket_comment cm ON cm.ticket_id = t.id AND cm.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.name
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。

cases.question: 处理人 5 负责的工单里，各优先级的工单数量分别是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT priority, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND assignee_id = 5 GROUP BY priority
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。

cases.question: 每个分类的工单平均解决时长（小时）是多少？只算已解决的
cases.goldSql: SELECT c.name, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, t.created_at, t.resolved_at)) AS avg_hours FROM ticket t JOIN ticket_category c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.resolved_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.name
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。

cases.question: 2025 年关闭的工单里，超时关闭（关闭时间晚于 SLA 截止时间）的有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'CLOSED' AND closed_at IS NOT NULL AND closed_at > sla_deadline
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 评论一共有多少条？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket_comment WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 流转记录一共有多少条？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket_flow WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 状态为处理中的工单有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 来自 APP 的工单有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND source = 'APP'
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 分类名称叫「订单与支付」的工单有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket t JOIN ticket_category c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND c.name = '订单与支付'
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 平均优先级是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT AVG(priority) AS avg_priority FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 最高优先级（数字最小）的工单有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND priority = 1
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 处理过工单的不同处理人有多少个？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT assignee_id) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND assignee_id IS NOT NULL
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 按团队统计工单数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT team_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY team_id
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 6 行。

cases.question: 按是否内部备注统计评论数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT is_internal, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket_comment WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY is_internal
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 2 行。

cases.question: 2025 年 1 月创建的工单按状态统计数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-02-01' GROUP BY status
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 4 行。

cases.question: 每个分类的平均 AI 置信度是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT c.name, AVG(t.ai_confidence) AS avg_conf FROM ticket t JOIN ticket_category c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.name
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。

cases.question: 评论数超过 2 条的工单有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM (SELECT ticket_id FROM ticket_comment WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY ticket_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) x
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 状态为已关闭的工单，平均有多少条评论？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS avg_comment FROM ticket t JOIN ticket_comment cm ON cm.ticket_id = t.id AND cm.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 'CLOSED'
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 按来源统计内部备注数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT t.source, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket t JOIN ticket_comment cm ON cm.ticket_id = t.id AND cm.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND cm.is_internal = 1 GROUP BY t.source
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 4 行。

cases.question: 2025 年 11 月创建的工单有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= '2025-11-01' AND created_at < '2025-12-01'
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 处理团队 1 和团队 2 各有多少张工单？
cases.goldSql: SELECT team_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND team_id IN (1, 2) GROUP BY team_id
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 2 行。

cases.question: 每个分类下已解决（含已关闭）的工单有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket t JOIN ticket_category c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED') GROUP BY c.name
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。

cases.question: 流转记录里「OPEN 变到 IN_PROGRESS」发生了多少次？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket_flow WHERE deleted = 0 AND from_status = 'OPEN' AND to_status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 按流转前后状态组合统计流转次数
cases.goldSql: SELECT from_status, to_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket_flow WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY from_status, to_status
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。

cases.question: 各优先级的工单平均解决时长（小时）是多少？只算已解决的
cases.goldSql: SELECT priority, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, created_at, resolved_at)) AS avg_hours FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY priority
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。

cases.question: 2025 年为已关闭状态的工单占 2025 年全部工单的比例是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS ratio FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND created_at < '2026-01-01'
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 有评论的工单占比是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0) AS ratio FROM ticket t JOIN ticket_comment cm ON cm.ticket_id = t.id AND cm.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 各分类的工单中，内部备注占全部评论的比例分别是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT c.name, SUM(CASE WHEN cm.is_internal = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS ratio FROM ticket t JOIN ticket_category c ON t.category_id = c.id JOIN ticket_comment cm ON cm.ticket_id = t.id AND cm.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.name
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。

cases.question: 2025 年创建的工单中，AI 推荐分类准确（AI 分类与实际分类一致）的比例是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ai_category_id = category_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS ratio FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND created_at < '2026-01-01'
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 按优先级统计平均流转次数
cases.goldSql: SELECT t.priority, COUNT(f.id) / COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS avg_flow FROM ticket t JOIN ticket_flow f ON f.ticket_id = t.id AND f.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.priority
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。

cases.question: 已关闭工单中，关闭时间早于 SLA 截止时间的比例是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN closed_at <= sla_deadline THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS ratio FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'CLOSED' AND closed_at IS NOT NULL
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 2025 年 4 月创建的工单里，已关闭的有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'CLOSED' AND created_at >= '2025-04-01' AND created_at < '2025-05-01'
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 各分类下工单的平均优先级是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT c.name, AVG(t.priority) AS avg_priority FROM ticket t JOIN ticket_category c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.name
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。

cases.question: 有解决时间的工单，平均解决时长是多少小时？
cases.goldSql: SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, created_at, resolved_at)) AS avg_hours FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 处理人 7 的工单里，平均解决时长（小时）是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, created_at, resolved_at)) AS avg_hours FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND assignee_id = 7 AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 已解决的工单占全部工单的比例是多少？用 0 到 1 之间的小数表示
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'RESOLVED' THEN ticket_no END) / COUNT(ticket_no) AS ratio FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 已解决且优先级高于 2 的工单有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'RESOLVED' AND priority > 2
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 还没完成的工单（待处理或处理中）有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS')
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 已解决的工单有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'RESOLVED'
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 1 行。

cases.question: 工单数最多的 5 个分类分别是哪几个？
cases.goldSql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket t JOIN ticket_category c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。

cases.question: 各分类的工单数占全部工单数的比例分别是多少？用 0 到 1 之间的小数表示
cases.goldSql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0) AS ratio FROM ticket t JOIN ticket_category c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.name
cases.note: 夹具数据；gold 结果 5 行。
